milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the andesite deposit (centered at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. The deposit is verified at spawn-relative (4-7, -1 to 2, 4-6) per sandbox screenshots. max_distance=16 is generous since the deposit is only ~7 blocks from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the andesite.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='andesite') because this is a build/place task. An archway gate requires two vertical pillars and a horizontal top beam — minimum 7 blocks (2 pillars of 3 blocks each + 1 lintel on top). The bounding box covers the building area near the gold block markers at spawn-relative (-5 to -3, 0, 6-9) with generous padding (x: -8 to 0, y: 0 to 5, z: 3 to 12) to allow creative freedom in exact placement. The box does NOT overlap with the existing andesite deposit (which is at x=4-7), preventing false positives from pre-placed blocks.
